name: thufir
description: Autonomous root cause analysis for production incidents. Integrates with Prometheus, GitHub, and GitLab to investigate alerts, analyze metrics, search code, trace git history, and generate comprehensive RCA reports.
features: Autonomous investigation of Prometheus alerts, GitHub issues, and GitLab issues
Automatic metric correlation with 100+ PromQL query patterns
Codebase search with error string matching
Git history analysis with blame, log, and bisect
Timeline reconstruction correlating code changes with incidents
Five Whys methodology for systematic root cause identification
Professional RCA report generation in markdown format
3 MCP server integrations for external data sources
useCases: SRE incident response and post-mortem documentation

prometheus.description: Prometheus server endpoint for metrics analysis

github.description: GitHub personal access token for issue and repository access

gitlab.description: GitLab personal access token for issue and project access
